name: Grok Bot Notify
description: Hands Orca's agent alerts (done, waiting, blocked) from Orca's agent.status.changed hook to Grok Bot. The alert half of orca-helm.

settings.title: Grok Bot routine URL
settings.description: The routine's URL from the Grok Bot routine screen. Orca alerts are POSTed here.

settings.title: States
settings.description: Comma-separated agent states to hand to Grok Bot: done, waiting, blocked, working.

settings.title: Debounce seconds
settings.description: Seconds to hold back the same state again for the same terminal. A state change in between resets it.

settings.title: Authorization value
settings.description: The Authorization value from the Grok Bot routine screen. Paste it once; the worker moves it into encrypted secrets and clears this field.
